title: MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD
description: Generate speech from text prompts and different voices using the MiniMax Speech-2.8 HD model, which leverages advanced AI techniques to create high-quality text-to-speech.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: Text to convert to speech. Use `<#x#>` for pauses (x = 0.01-99.99 seconds). Supports interjection tags: `(laughs)`, `(sighs)`, `(coughs)`, `(clears throat)`, `(gasps)`, `(sniffs)`, `(groans)`, `(yawns)`.

inputs.name: voice_setting_speed
inputs.tooltip: Speech speed (0.5-2.0)

inputs.name: voice_setting_vol
inputs.tooltip: Volume (0-10)

inputs.name: voice_setting_english_normalization
inputs.tooltip: Enables English text normalization to improve number reading performance, with a slight increase in latency

inputs.name: voice_setting_pitch
inputs.tooltip: Voice pitch (-12 to 12)

inputs.name: voice_setting_emotion
inputs.tooltip: Emotion of the generated speech '(not set)' leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: voice_setting_voice_id
inputs.tooltip: Predefined voice ID to use for synthesis Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: audio_setting_format
inputs.tooltip: Audio format

inputs.name: audio_setting_bitrate
inputs.tooltip: Bitrate of generated audio

inputs.name: audio_setting_sample_rate
inputs.tooltip: Sample rate of generated audio

inputs.name: audio_setting_channel
inputs.tooltip: Number of audio channels (1=mono, 2=stereo)

inputs.name: language_boost
inputs.tooltip: Enhance recognition of specified languages and dialects '(not set)' leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: Format of the output content (non-streaming only)

inputs.name: pronunciation_dict
inputs.tooltip: Custom pronunciation dictionary for text replacement JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: normalization_setting_target_range
inputs.tooltip: Target loudness range in LU (default 8.0)

inputs.name: normalization_setting_target_loudness
inputs.tooltip: Target loudness in LUFS (default -18.0)

inputs.name: normalization_setting_enabled
inputs.tooltip: Enable loudness normalization for the audio

inputs.name: normalization_setting_target_peak
inputs.tooltip: Target peak level in dBTP (default -0.5).

inputs.name: voice_modify_pitch
inputs.tooltip: Pitch adjustment in semitones. Range: -100 to 100. Positive values raise pitch, negative values lower it.

inputs.name: voice_modify_intensity
inputs.tooltip: Intensity/energy of the voice. Range: -100 to 100. Higher values create more energetic speech.

inputs.name: voice_modify_timbre
inputs.tooltip: Timbre adjustment. Range: -100 to 100. Affects the tonal quality of the voice.
